28:18.text: And Jesus came and said to them, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.
28:18.notes: Agrees with the RSV cache entry unless noted.

28:19.text: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
28:19.notes: Agrees with the RSV cache entry unless noted.

28:20.text: teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you; and lo, I am with you always, to the close of the age."

10:16.text: Behold, I send you out as sheep in the midst of wolves; so be wise as serpents and innocent as doves.

16:24.text: Then Jesus told his disciples, "If any man would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.

16:25.text: For whoever would save his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for my sake will find it.

22:37.text: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind.

22:38.text: This is the great and first commandment.

22:39.text: And a second is like it, You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
